unit: One field_id and one source hypothesis per iteration, never bundle 30 other settings into same loop

first_sweep.order: Read 204 seed entries by declared source order, each field exactly once; no source found counts as researched-with-UNKNOWN only, never verified

next_sweeps.order: Prioritize high risk/conflict, missing credible source, decision impact, new Gemini REA evidence; one field per iteration
next_sweeps.full_sweep_no_progress: Pause as PARTIAL with exact evidence and continue only upon new sources/input, not fake progress

steps: Recover remote HEAD, current checkpoint, source queue; ensure clean worktree/branch before writing
Pick one field_id and write one falsifiable source question
Actually search official, same-platform and community materials and compare existing game mechanism guides
Record URLs, author/date, original claim and whether game/platform/version applies; separate proven reference from hypothesis
Report contradictory information, numeric impact as UNKNOWN unless directly supported and game-verified
Provide a bounded REA observation/experiment question, expected measurable result and confounders
Write one individual dossier + one append-only iteration record with source grades and checkpoint; commit same branch; move cursor
per_item_unsupported: If no relevant source or new evidence after a repeated strategy, record NO_DIRECT_SOURCE/BLOCKED_FIELD and advance rather than generating an assumed formula
cross_model_contract: Use identical field_id with Gemini REA stream and exact SHA; GPT findings can guide REA but cannot certify native mapping or real effect. Human relays results at checkpoints, not automated.
review: Combined independent GPT once frozen release is prepared; not per field
model_identity: assigned GPT-6; actual recorded from executor with runtime evidence limits
